purpose: Exploit the film trilogy's ensemble structure so gameplay is not forced through Frodo when another character is the natural viewpoint. Direct film scenes become playable missions where useful; original expansion only fills safe gaps around those scenes.
non_negotiable_rules: Choose the playable viewpoint from the film event, not from a rule that Frodo must always be controlled.
FILM_CORE scene order, participants and outcome are checked against available film/script sources before implementation.
A character may not be pulled into an optional mission if that would make them absent from their next required film scene.
When the film already gives a character a meaningful action, prefer turning that action into gameplay before inventing filler.
Original gap-fill may add preparation, scouting, travel, conversation, training, investigation, craft, survival or local help, but never a new major plot result.
Parallel missions may run while Frodo is off-screen, resting, separated, imprisoned, injured or simply not present in the film event.
Every optional expansion yields immediately when the next mandatory film beat begins.

content_tags.FILM_CORE_PLAYABLE: A required film event converted into direct player control without changing its result.
content_tags.FILM_EXTENDED_PLAYABLE: An Extended Edition film event/detail made playable when it does not conflict with the theatrical core.
content_tags.FILM_INTERSTITIAL: A plausible off-camera activity inside a verified gap between two film anchors.
content_tags.CHARACTER_SPECIALTY: Optional gameplay that expresses a character's established skill while they are already present in that story window.
content_tags.FUTURE_SOURCE_CHECK: Route opportunity is known at high level, but exact mission timing/details are not authored until the film/script source is verified.

priority: character who performs the film action
character whose specialty best expresses the event
Frodo only when the Ring-bearer viewpoint is actually the scene's dramatic center
viewpoint_policy.handoff_style: Short handoffs can be automatic at chapter/scene boundaries; longer parallel routes keep their own saved route state and rejoin at a verified convergence point.

production_rule: Before implementing any mission entry, bind it to verified opening/closing film anchors and record viewpoint availability. FUTURE_SOURCE_CHECK entries are not implementation authority until verified.
